description: TAX-0B/C/D measurement companion to the frozen TAX-0A2 preregistration census (tax0a2-control-plane-topology.json). Additive: this file registers measured results and hypothesis_status outcomes; it does not modify the preregistration. All numbers are ENVIRONMENT-LIMITED (WSL2, virtualized PMU, virtual ext4) — control-plane user-instruction attribution pilot, never native throughput conclusions.

z_ladder_results.units: user instructions per operation (median-of-reps via double difference)
z_ladder_results.structural_finding: Z2-Z1b is a FIXED ~2015 instr/op independent of request size (control-plane per-op work), while Z1b-Z1 is ~+37/op; both vanish into the data plane's relative noise at 64K/1M
z_ladder_results.wall_note: wall/op at 4K is kernel-medium-dominated on this host (z2 wall can be LOWER than z1/z1b at depth>=8); instructions/op is the campaign's primary metric and the only basis for control-plane claims

historical_cliff_rejudgment.evidence: z3w4 vs z3w1 at 4K d32: +0.6% instructions (3924 vs 3899), +40% wall; at 4K d64: +0.8% / +54% — smooth in depth, no threshold discontinuity
historical_cliff_rejudgment.scope_caveat: historical #221 evidence was ThreadPool-backend on WSL2/tmpfs; this re-judgment covers the uring Z-ladder path in the current environment only

seam_outcomes.scope: multi-worker write cells unmeasured (z3w4 write instability, see observations)

measured.handwritten_floor_z1bw: +210 instr/op at d32 amortized; +767 at d1 (cross-thread futex wake dominates wall at shallow depth: 46us/op on this host)
measured.reading: a hand-written same-semantic continuation (park/wake/lost-wake-safe one-shot wait, exactly-once terminal, stale protection) demonstrably costs a fraction of the Z3 premium at amortized depth; the Z3-specific remainder (+577 at d32) is waiter-registration/routing/scheduler machinery — candidate accidental cost, decomposed only STRUCTURAL_ONLY (no per-component ablation)

seam_outcomes.comparison_guard: z1bw is NOT a poll loop: it purchases the frozen checklist semantics for the compared cell (no cancel, one consumer). Z3 additionally carries capabilities the compared cells do not exercise (cancel race closure, cross-worker wake, TLA+-verified routing); those stay REQUIRED-if-USED, UNMEASURED here

observations.severity: potential production defect (NOT a tax finding)
observations.summary: Intermittent spurious 'canceled' terminal (IoError code 1) with os_errno=125 (EAGAIN) surfacing through Completion::result() on the ApplicationRuntime WRITE path (workers=4, depth>=32, no cancel ever requested), plus a separate intermittent 'terminate called without an active exception' teardown abort under perf-stat wrapping. Standalone probes pass (11/12, 5/5); in-session combos failed all bounded retries (formal2 4/4, formal3 3/4). z3w1 and all read cells unaffected. NOT root-caused in this campaign; measured cells degraded to no-perf wrapper (wall/user/sys + same-work only). Follow-up recommended in #250.
write>>read wall asymmetry at shallow depth reproduced (4K d1 write 39-70us/op vs read 1.6us/op; vanishes at depth>=8) — carries the v1.1 UNKNOWN forward as ENVIRONMENT-SPECIFIC-until-native
